bagPolicy.summary: For safety and expedited entry, bags at Canada Life Centre must be 12”x 9”x 5” or smaller and will undergo contactless security screening. On-site bag check is not available.
bagPolicy.note: Exceptions are made for guests with medical and childcare/diaper bags and for media.

parking.note: True North Sports + Entertainment has partnered with Platinum Parking to offer over 1,700 parking stalls for events. Guests are encouraged to reserve parking in advance via ParkMobile or ParkWhiz.

rideshare.note: Pickup and drop-off options include the east curb of Donald Street between Portage and Graham, either curb of Donald south of Graham, and eastbound Portage between Carlton and Hargrave. The west curb of Donald between Portage and Graham is for Handi-Transit only.

concessions.note: Canada Life Centre offers a variety of food and beverage options through permanent concession stands and portable kiosks, featuring well-known items like Tim Hortons and Pizza Pizza. All transactions are cashless for an expedited payment experience.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Accessible drop-off and pick-up is located on the west lane of Donald Street beside Canada Life Centre.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: Guests attending any event at Canada Life Centre will not be allowed to re-enter the arena after exiting.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: The Canada Life Centre Box Office/Will Call is located at street level at the corner of Portage Avenue and Donald Street in the main atrium (Gate 1).

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: The main atrium entrance, Gate 1, is at Portage Avenue and Donald Street, where the Box Office and coat check are. Guests with medical or diaper bags must enter at Gate 1, Gate 3 (Graham and Hargrave), or Gate 6 Cityplace Skywalk for X-ray screening.
